patterns.note: Content is primarily centered on a full-bleed, dark background, creating a focused and dramatic presentation.
There is an extreme contrast in typography, featuring an oversized, highly ornate display font for the brand name against very small, understated sans-serif text for all other information.
A deep, dark background (almost black) serves as a canvas for a single vibrant accent color and highly reflective, metallic visual effects.
The hero brand name undergoes a multi-stage scroll-triggered transformation, scaling, changing material properties, and repositioning as the user scrolls down the page.
The page functions as a continuous, single-canvas experience where content reveals and transforms in place, rather than being broken into distinct, separated sections.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate a complex, multi-stage animation of the hero brand name. As the user scrolls, the brand name first scales up, then transforms its visual style from a flat, outlined graphic to a glossy, metallic 3D rendering, while simultaneously scaling down and repositioning to reveal utility links and copyright information.
The main brand name is rendered with a highly reflective, almost liquid metal effect, giving it a sculptural quality that contrasts sharply with the flat, dark background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extreme contrast with an oversized, ornate hero title (~8x body) and very small, understated body/utility text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons, otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero section, with significant negative space and minimal content density.

standout: The highly stylized, animated 3D logo that transforms and scales on scroll, combined with a very dark, minimalist aesthetic, creates a distinctive luxurious and artistic brand presence that immediately communicates a high-end creative service.
